answer: Locks are recorded in karst, expire in sable, and oasis lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 123 aliases therefore needs 27 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 847 identities would post 3338 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
